title: A user-friendly package and workflow for generating effective homogeneous rheologies for the study of the long-term orbital evolution of multilayered planetary bodies
summary: We present a user-friendly, open-source Wolfram Language package that automates the construction of an effective homogeneous generalized Voigt rheology for a spherically symmetric, incompressible layered body with Maxwell solid layers. It provides a practical bridge between layered interior models and time-domain simulations of tidal evolution.
